author: Techno Tim
description:
Mini racks are easy to fill with switches, mini PCs, and storage. The harder part is everything around that hardware. 

In this video, I test accessories for 10-inch mini racks, including cooling, power distribution, patch panels, rackmount displays, a network KVM, lighting, cable management, USB-C-to-DC adapters, tiny casters, and a compact UPS. 

Some of these products worked really well, some more limited than I expected, and a few showed where the mini-rack ecosystem still has room to improve. 

Some products were sent to me for testing, others I bought myself. This video is not sponsored, and none of the companies had any input into this video.

title: The Mini Rack Accessories You Didn’t Know You Needed
